title: Chauvet Cave paintings
summary: The Chauvet-Pont d'Arc cave, by the entrance to the Gorges of the Ardèche in southern France beside the Pont d'Arc natural archway, holds cave paintings that CNRS describes as the world's oldest, dating back 36,000 years. World History Encyclopedia gives a later range of about 33,000 to 30,000 years ago.

uncertainty.note: Years are rounded from the sources' "years ago" figures (36,000 to 30,000 years ago); the two sources differ.

as_recorded.value: the world's oldest cave paintings, dating back 36,000 years
